<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Security measures in the capital:</strong> Authorities have deployed BSF units at the Delhi-Gurugram border and implemented extensive traffic curbs and surveillance measures to manage the competing political demonstrations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
